hook: An AI model estimates global rain every 15 minutes at 0.1 degrees and beats IMERG, ERA5 and HRES
summary: PARDIG is a graph transformer trained on atmospheric analyses and geostationary imagery to predict spaceborne radar rainfall, then applied everywhere. Checks against radar networks in the US, Europe and Japan and over 36,000 stations show gains over IMERG V07, MSWEP V3, ERA5 and HRES, most at extreme rain. Its training targets cover limited radar swaths, so skill in unsampled regimes is less certain.
title: PARDIG: Global Precipitation Estimates Learned from Sparse Satellite Observations
